test_overview:
Evaluated the regression test plan for MVP City Match calculation and Save Quote after Rate Cards changes. Server at http://localhost:8000 was accessible; seeded data (Warehouse Central/Metroville location, 3-Seater Sofa catalog item) confirmed. 

Step 1 (test_city_match_calculation): Created a B2C quote with origin Warehouse Central, destination city "Easton", suburb blank, 3-Seater Sofa x1, and all services at 0. Clicked Calculate Quote. Result showed the "City Match" tier badge (not Exact Match, not Unavailable), Rate per m³ $130.00, the City Match explanatory message "3 suburbs available for this city." (correctly counting unique suburbs: Riverside counted once despite duplicate rate card, plus Lakeside and Old Town), Total $156.00 with two decimals, and an available/enabled "Save Quote" button. All verifications passed — 12/12 points.

Step 2 (test_save_quote): Clicked Save Quote; "Quote saved successfully!" confirmation shown. Navigated to the Quotes list; the saved quote appeared with B2C type badge, route "Metroville → Easton" (empty suburb omitted, acceptable), City Match badge, and $156.00 total. Opened the detail view: Rate per m³ $130.00, Volume Charged 1.20 m³, Total $156.00. Non-fatal immutability check passed — no edit controls exist on list or detail views, so the quote behaves as an immutable snapshot. All verifications passed — 8/8 points.

Total score: 20/20.
